name: Akifumi
source:
The student council president, Akifumi is both methodical and disciplined.

However, he also loves 2D characters and idols, and doesn't mind using other students for his own hobbies as the student council president.

The vice-president of the student council, Juri, is on the same wavelength of him. However, he seems to be worried about his childhood friend, Riya...

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/akifumi.html]official wesbite[/url]]
